raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Keep the existing DFlash windowed-draft FA3 AOT safeguard after full cache allocation. Use the draft implementations' computation windows when the allocation-spec helper no longer reports one.

## Claims

- Preserve the disabled AOT schedule for windowed DFlash/DFlash2/DSpark computation after cache promotion.
- Keep full-attention drafts enabled even when a shared allocation spec inherits a target window; leave the allocation helper unchanged.
- Also disable AOT when Laguna DFlash clears its allocation window but retains windowed computation, including without cache promotion; verified with a real-constructor control.

## Validation

On H100, the new LLM regression fails on public base7b77ed581 with `assert True is (128 is None)` for the promoted windowed draft. Candidate0a693f7b2 passes4tests: three real-constructor allocation controls and a three-arm LLM regression with nonzero speculation and FULL graph dispatch.39neighbor/allocation-helper contract tests pass. Normal hooks, mypy, CI tethering and DCO pass.

```sh
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -vv -s tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/test_dflash_fa3_aot.py
```

The trained Qwen3-4B/DFlash-b16 head is explicitly configured with a128-token window through native hf_overrides for this regression; this changes its released full-attention computation. It is not qualification of a released window-trained checkpoint. In a first32-question, five-shot GSM8K screen, base/promoted, candidate/promoted and candidate/native all score29/32 with1101drafts/3391accepted tokens. Both upstream logprob comparisons pass; all32token sequences match in this run. Draft/acceptance counters are also identical: this fixture does not reproduce #54374's wrong-geometry case, and target GSM8K accuracy does not measure draft quality. Motivation is preserving that merged safeguard policy. No numerical improvement or speedup is claimed; affected-path runtime cost is unbenchmarked.

## Details

FullAttentionSpec retains a window after promotion, but a merged group's field may come from the target. The existing allocation helper deliberately returnsNone for full allocation. Retain that helper and check the group's own draft Attention layers as a startup fallback. Laguna DFlash clears the layer allocation field while its implementation keeps computing windowed, so read implementation variants rather than that field. A real-constructor control reproduces that allocation-only override; a Laguna checkpoint run is not qualified. The extracted startup helper permits real-constructor inverse controls without fabricating a speculator. No steady-state instrumentation is added.

[#54374](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54374) added the original guard. Open[#64404](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64404) generalizes it to other drafters/builders but retains the promoted-window gap; it conflicts with this block. If it lands first, move this draft-layer predicate into its shared helper and repeat the tests before submitting. This patch targets the existing DFlash-family guard only.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Startup-only guard preservation, scoped to existing DFlash-family behavior; allocation helper unchanged.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Real base failure/candidate pass, constructor controls, trained-weight generation and scoped GSM8K controls; dedicated H100 CI selection.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Normal hooks/mypy pass; no new user-facing API/configuration or steady-state work.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Documents motivation, implementation, validation, limitations and related work; assistance disclosure is included.
</details>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.models.utils import check_logprobs_close
+
+from .utils import compute_acceptance_rate
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("draft_window", "full_allocation"), [(None, False), (128, False), (128, True)]
+)
+def test_draft_aot_uses_own_window_after_group_merge(
+    dist_init, draft_window, full_allocation
+):
+    from vllm.config import (
+        AttentionConfig,
+        CacheConfig,
+        CompilationConfig,
+        ModelConfig,
+        SchedulerConfig,
+        VllmConfig,
+        set_current_vllm_config,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.flash_attn import (
+        FlashAttentionBackend,
+        FlashAttentionImpl,
+        FlashAttentionMetadataBuilder,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.triton_attn import TritonAttentionBackend
+    from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning import get_kv_cache_groups
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+        FullAttentionSpec,
+        get_kv_cache_spec_sliding_window,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dflash.speculator import (
+        _disable_aot_schedule_for_sliding_window_drafts,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.worker.utils import AttentionGroup
+
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(
+            model="Qwen/Qwen3-4B",
+            revision="1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c",
+            dtype="bfloat16",
+            max_model_len=512,
+        ),
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(block_size=16),
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(cudagraph_mode="NONE"),
+        scheduler_config=SchedulerConfig(
+            max_model_len=512,
+            is_encoder_decoder=False,
+            max_num_seqs=2,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=512,
+            disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=True,
+        ),
+        attention_config=AttentionConfig(flash_attn_version=3),
+    )
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        layers = {
+            name: Attention(
+                1,
+                128,
+                128**-0.5,
+                num_kv_heads=1,
+                cache_config=config.cache_config,
+                per_layer_sliding_window=window,
+                prefix=name,
+                attn_backend=backend,
+            )
+            for name, window, backend in (
+                ("target", None if draft_window else 128, TritonAttentionBackend),
+                ("draft", draft_window, FlashAttentionBackend),
+            )
+        }
+        if full_allocation:
+            # Match DFlashLagunaModel's allocation-only override.
+            layers["draft"].sliding_window = None
+        for impl in layers["draft"].impl.get_impl_variants():
+            assert isinstance(impl, FlashAttentionImpl)
+            assert impl.sliding_window == ((127, 0) if draft_window else (-1, -1))
+        specs = {
+            name: spec
+            for name, layer in layers.items()
+            if (spec := layer.get_kv_cache_spec(config)) is not None
+        }
+        assert len(specs) == 2
+        groups = get_kv_cache_groups(config, specs)
+        assert len(groups) == 1
+        spec = groups[0].kv_cache_spec
+        assert isinstance(spec, FullAttentionSpec)
+        assert spec.sliding_window == (None if full_allocation else 128)
+        assert get_kv_cache_spec_sliding_window(spec) is None
+        builder = FlashAttentionMetadataBuilder(
+            spec, ["draft"], config, torch.device("cpu")
+        )
+        group = AttentionGroup(
+            FlashAttentionBackend, ["draft"], spec, 0, metadata_builders=[builder]
+        )
+        assert builder.aot_schedule
+        _disable_aot_schedule_for_sliding_window_drafts(config, [[group]])
+        assert builder.aot_schedule is (draft_window is None)
+
+
+def _windowed_dflash(config):
+    # Configure a real trained full-attention head as a windowed regression fixture.
+    if getattr(config, "dflash_config", None):
+        config.sliding_window = 128
+        config.use_sliding_window = True
+        config.dflash_config = {**config.dflash_config, "use_swa": True}
+    return config
+
+
+def _dflash_aot_state(worker):
+    from vllm.config import get_layers_from_vllm_config
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import get_kv_cache_spec_sliding_window
+
+    draft = worker.model_runner.speculator
+    layers = get_layers_from_vllm_config(
+        draft.vllm_config, Attention, draft.draft_attn_layer_names
+    )
+    builders = [
+        group.get_metadata_builder() for groups in draft.attn_groups for group in groups
+    ]
+    manager = draft.query_cudagraph_manager
+    return {
+        "windows": [layer.sliding_window for layer in layers.values()],
+        "builders": [
+            {
+                "type": type(builder).__name__,
+                "spec": type(builder.kv_cache_spec).__name__,
+                "spec_window": builder.kv_cache_spec.sliding_window,
+                "allocation_window": get_kv_cache_spec_sliding_window(
+                    builder.kv_cache_spec
+                ),
+                "aot": builder.aot_schedule,
+            }
+            for builder in builders
+        ],
+        "graphs": len(manager.graphs),
+        "dispatch": [
+            manager.dispatch(
+                num_reqs=n,
+                num_tokens=n * draft.num_query_per_req,
+                uniform_token_count=draft.num_query_per_req,
+                num_active_loras=0,
+            ).cg_mode.name
+            for n in (1, 2)
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def test_dflash_fa3_window_guard_survives_cache_promotion(monkeypatch, vllm_runner):
+    """Keep the real FA3 guard through full allocation and FULL graph decoding."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD", "spawn")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", "0")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION", "1")
+    outputs = []
+    for window, promote in ((None, True), (128, False), (128, True)):
+        with vllm_runner(
+            "Qwen/Qwen3-4B",
+            revision="1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c",
+            dtype="bfloat16",
+            max_model_len=4096,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=512,
+            max_num_seqs=2,
+            kv_cache_memory_bytes=2 * 1024**3,
+            enable_prefix_caching=False,
+            enable_chunked_prefill=True,
+            async_scheduling=False,
+            enforce_eager=False,
+            disable_hybrid_kv_cache_manager=promote,
+            disable_log_stats=False,
+            hf_overrides=_windowed_dflash if window else None,
+            attention_config={"backend": "TRITON_ATTN", "flash_attn_version": 3},
+            compilation_config={"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [16, 32]},
+            speculative_config={
+                "method": "dflash",
+                "model": "z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16",
+                "revision": "b74e3a329c4d963783143b1e970d95b002be72bd",
+                "num_speculative_tokens": 15,
+                "attention_backend": "FLASH_ATTN",
+            },
+        ) as model:
+            tokenizer = model.llm.get_tokenizer()
+            prompts = [
+                tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
+                    [{"role": "user", "content": content}],
+                    tokenize=False,
+                    add_generation_prompt=True,
+                    enable_thinking=False,
+                )
+                for content in (
+                    "What is 2 + 2? Give the answer only.",
+                    "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. " * 260
+                    + "What animal jumps? Answer briefly.",
+                )
+            ]
+            assert len(tokenizer.encode(prompts[1])) > 128
+            outputs.append(model.generate_greedy_logprobs(prompts, 32, 5))
+            state = model.llm.collective_rpc(_dflash_aot_state)[0]
+            assert state["windows"] and set(state["windows"]) == {window}
+            assert state["builders"]
+            for builder in state["builders"]:
+                assert builder["type"] == "FlashAttentionMetadataBuilder"
+                assert builder["spec"] == (
+                    "SlidingWindowSpec"
+                    if window and not promote
+                    else "FullAttentionSpec"
+                )
+                assert builder["spec_window"] == window
+                assert builder["allocation_window"] == (window if not promote else None)
+                assert builder["aot"] is (window is None)
+            assert state["graphs"] >= 2
+            assert state["dispatch"] == ["FULL", "FULL"]
+            metrics = model.llm.get_metrics()
+            assert (
+                next(
+                    metric.value
+                    for metric in metrics
+                    if metric.name == "vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts"
+                )
+                > 0
+            )
+            assert compute_acceptance_rate(metrics) > 0
+    for i in (1, 2):
+        check_logprobs_close(
+            outputs_0_lst=outputs[0],
+            outputs_1_lst=outputs[i],
+            name_0="full-attention draft control",
+            name_1="windowed draft with "
+            + ("full" if i == 2 else "native")
+            + " allocation",
+            always_check_logprobs=True,
+        )
